steps.action: OpenLaw checks the account's actual role, whichever sign-in page the person opened
steps.expected: With Legal password sign-in off, a Legal Team Member is refused on the Portal page too; a Business User with a password signs in on the staff page and lands in the Portal
steps.actual: With Email and password off under Legal User Authentication, Nadia's password sign-in on the Business Portal page was refused ("Password sign-in is disabled for this account."; me 401). A Business User's password sign-in on the staff page succeeded and landed on /portal/onboarding (business_user). Legal password sign-in was turned back on.

steps.action: Business Users sign in only with the methods enabled under Business Portal Authentication
steps.expected: With Business Email and password off, a Business User with a password is refused on the Portal and staff pages; a sign-in link still works
steps.actual: With Email and password off under Business Portal Authentication ("Saved"), the Portal page offered only ["Send link","Back to sign-in"], with no password choice. On the staff page, where Legal users still have a password form, the Business User's password sign-in was refused with "Password sign-in is disabled for this account." (me 401). A sign-in link still signed the same person in as business_user. Business password sign-in was turned back on.
